purpose: Teach: 王道/東京タワー/大相撲/バッター/金メダル/声優/ジョギング/レア

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、王道、絶対、のアニメ、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I really watched this anime — the classic one, you know? I'm serious.
lines.style: Bright, open, eager to share. Quick breathing between thoughts. Lean forward slightly in the voice. The pace is fast — almost breathless with excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、東京タワー、絶対、お写真、絶対、送ってくださったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad really did send me photos from Tokyo Tower — can you believe it?
lines.style: Warm surprise with delight threaded through. Lift up slightly on 'Tokyo Tower.' Rhythmic, animated. Speaking to him like he'll appreciate the genuineness of the detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、大相撲、絶対、テレビで、絶対、見てたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was really watching sumo wrestling on TV the whole time.
lines.style: Quiet observation, like he's noticing something about his dad. Slower pace. Thoughtful — not complaining, just taking it in. Slight pause before 'the whole time.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、バッター、絶対、頑張ってね
lines.en: Sho, you're going to do your best at bat, okay? I really mean it.
lines.style: Firm but gentle. Direct eye contact in the voice. Steady, encouraging tone — not saccharine, just present. Light emphasis on 'really mean it' to signal this is true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、金メダル、絶対、取りたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to win a gold medal someday.
lines.style: Soft wish, not boastful. Opening word is almost dreamy. Slow, sincere. Trailing upward slightly on 'someday' — the future tense of longing, not certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お気に入りの、本気で、絶対、声優、絶対、いるの?本気で
lines.en: Sho, do you have a favorite voice actor? Someone you really like?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity — not testing him, asking because she wants to know. Warm, conversational pace. Slight lean-in on 'favorite,' then settle back for the answer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんと、本気で、絶対、ジョギング、絶対、行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I really did go jogging together.
lines.style: Small pride in his voice. Matter-of-fact, but with a thread of quiet joy underneath. Steady pace. The word 'together' lands softly but clearly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの、本気で、絶対、レア、絶対、なお皿、絶対、大切なのよ
lines.en: Sho, this plate of mine — the rare one — it's very precious to me. You understand that, don't you?
lines.style: Tender but serious. Slow, deliberate opening. Slight breathiness — she's being careful, wanting him to hear the weight of it. The voice settles on 'precious,' landing it gently but unmistakably.
